1.zh: 耶稣基督的使徒彼得写信给那分散在本都、加拉太、加帕多家、亚细亚、庇推尼寄居的，
1.en: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

1.zh: 就是照父　神的先见被拣选，借着[圣]灵得成圣洁，以致顺服耶稣基督，又蒙他血所洒的人。愿恩惠、平安多多地加给你们。
1.en: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

1.zh: 愿颂赞归与我们主耶稣基督的父　神！他曾照自己的大怜悯，借耶稣基督从死里复活，重生了我们，叫我们有活泼的盼望，
1.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

1.zh: 可以得着不能朽坏、不能玷污、不能衰残、为你们存留在天上的基业。
1.en: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

1.zh: 你们这因信蒙　神能力保守的人，必能得着所预备、到末世要显现的救恩。
1.en: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

1.zh: 因此，你们是大有喜乐；但如今，在百般的试炼中暂时忧愁，
1.en: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

1.zh: 叫你们的信心既被试验，就比那被火试验仍然能坏的金子更显宝贵，可以在耶稣基督显现的时候得着称赞、荣耀、尊贵。
1.en: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

1.zh: 你们虽然没有见过他，却是爱他；如今虽不得看见，却因信他就有说不出来、满有荣光的大喜乐；
1.en: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

1.zh: 并且得着你们信心的果效，就是灵魂的救恩。
1.en: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

1.zh: 论到这救恩，那预先说你们要得恩典的众先知早已详细地寻求考察，
1.en: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

1.zh: 就是考察在他们心里基督的灵，预先证明基督受苦难，后来得荣耀，是指着什么时候，并怎样的时候。
1.en: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

1.zh: 他们得了启示，知道他们所传讲的一切事，不是为自己，乃是为你们。那靠着从天上差来的圣灵传福音给你们的人，现在将这些事报给你们；天使也愿意详细察看这些事。
1.en: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

1.zh: 所以要约束你们的心，谨慎自守，专心盼望耶稣基督显现的时候所带来给你们的恩。
1.en: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

1.zh: 你们既作顺命的儿女，就不要效法从前蒙昧无知的时候那放纵私欲的样子。
1.en: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

1.zh: 那召你们的既是圣洁，你们在一切所行的事上也要圣洁。
1.en: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

1.zh: 因为[经上]记着说：「你们要圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。」
1.en: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”

1.zh: 你们既称那不偏待人、按各人行为审判人的[主]为父，就当存敬畏的心度你们在世寄居的日子，
1.en: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

1.zh: 知道你们得赎，脱去你们祖宗所传流虚妄的行为，不是凭着能坏的金银等物，
1.en: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

1.zh: 乃是凭着基督的宝血，如同无瑕疵、无玷污的羔羊之血。
1.en: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

1.zh: 基督在创世以前是预先被　[神]知道的，却在这末世才为你们显现。
1.en: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

1.zh: 你们也因着他，信那叫他从死里复活、又给他荣耀的　神，叫你们的信心和盼望都在于　神。
1.en: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

1.zh: 你们既因顺从真理，洁净了自己的心，以致爱弟兄没有虚假，就当从心里彼此切实相爱。
1.en: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

1.zh: 你们蒙了重生，不是由于能坏的种子，乃是由于不能坏的种子，是借着　神活泼常存的道。
1.en: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

1.zh: 因为 凡有血气的，尽都如草； 他的美荣都像草上的花。 草必枯干，花必凋谢；
1.en: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

1.zh: 惟有主的道是永存的。 所传给你们的福音就是这道。
1.en: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

2.zh: 所以，你们既除去一切的恶毒、诡诈，并假善、嫉妒，和一切毁谤的话，
2.en: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

2.zh: 就要爱慕那纯净的灵奶，像才生的婴孩爱慕奶一样，叫你们因此渐长，以致得救。
2.en: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

2.zh: 你们若尝过主恩的滋味，[就必如此]。
2.en: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

2.zh: 主乃活石，固然是被人所弃的，却是被　神所拣选、所宝贵的。
2.en: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

2.zh: 你们来到主面前，也就像活石，被建造成为灵宫，作圣洁的祭司，借着耶稣基督奉献　神所悦纳的灵祭。
2.en: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

2.zh: 因为经上说： 看哪，我把所拣选、 所宝贵的房角石安放在锡安； 信靠他的人必不至于羞愧。
2.en: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

2.zh: 所以，他在你们信的人就为宝贵，在那不信的人[有话说]： 匠人所弃的石头 已作了房角的头块石头。
2.en: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”

2.zh: 又说：作了绊脚的石头，跌人的磐石。他们既不顺从，就在道理上绊跌；他们这样绊跌也是预定的。
2.en: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

2.zh: 惟有你们是被拣选的族类，是有君尊的祭司，是圣洁的国度，是属　[神]的子民，要叫你们宣扬那召你们出黑暗入奇妙光明者的美德。
2.en: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

2.zh: 你们从前算不得子民， 现在却作了　神的子民； 从前未曾蒙怜恤， 现在却蒙了怜恤。
2.en: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

2.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，你们是客旅，是寄居的。我劝你们要禁戒肉体的私欲；这私欲是与灵魂争战的。
2.en: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

2.zh: 你们在外邦人中，应当品行端正，叫那些毁谤你们是作恶的，因看见你们的好行为，便在鉴察的日子归荣耀给　神。
2.en: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

2.zh: 你们为主的缘故，要顺服人的一切制度，或是在上的君王，
2.en: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

2.zh: 或是君王所派罚恶赏善的臣宰。
2.en: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

2.zh: 因为　神的旨意原是要你们行善，可以堵住那糊涂无知人的口。
2.en: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

2.zh: 你们虽是自由的，却不可借着自由遮盖恶毒，总要作　神的仆人。
2.en: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

2.zh: 务要尊敬众人，亲爱教中的弟兄，敬畏　神，尊敬君王。
2.en: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

2.zh: 你们作仆人的，凡事要存敬畏的心顺服主人；不但顺服那善良温和的，就是那乖僻的也要顺服。
2.en: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

2.zh: 倘若人为叫良心对得住　神，就忍受冤屈的苦楚，这是可喜爱的。
2.en: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

2.zh: 你们若因犯罪受责打，能忍耐，有什么可夸的呢？但你们若因行善受苦，能忍耐，这在　神看是可喜爱的。
2.en: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

2.zh: 你们蒙召原是为此；因基督也为你们受过苦，给你们留下榜样，叫你们跟随他的脚踪行。
2.en: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

2.zh: 他并没有犯罪，口里也没有诡诈。
2.en: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”

2.zh: 他被骂不还口；受害不说威吓的话，只将自己交托那按公义审判人的[主]。
2.en: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

2.zh: 他被挂在木头上，亲身担当了我们的罪，使我们既然在罪上死，就得以在义上活。因他受的鞭伤，你们便得了医治。
2.en: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

2.zh: 你们从前好像迷路的羊，如今却归到你们灵魂的牧人监督了。
2.en: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

3.zh: 你们作妻子的要顺服自己的丈夫；这样，若有不信从道理的丈夫，他们虽然不听道，也可以因妻子的品行被感化过来；
3.en: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

3.zh: 这正是因看见你们有贞洁的品行和敬畏的心。
3.en: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

3.zh: 你们不要以外面的辫头发，戴金饰，穿美衣为妆饰，
3.en: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

3.zh: 只要以里面存着长久温柔、安静的心为妆饰；这在　神面前是极宝贵的。
3.en: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

3.zh: 因为古时仰赖　神的圣洁妇人正是以此为妆饰，顺服自己的丈夫，
3.en: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

3.zh: 就如撒拉听从亚伯拉罕，称他为主。你们若行善，不因恐吓而害怕，便是撒拉的女儿了。
3.en: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

3.zh: 你们作丈夫的也要按情理和[妻子]同住；因她比你软弱，与你一同承受生命之恩的，所以要敬重她。这样，便叫你们的祷告没有阻碍。
3.en: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

3.zh: 总而言之，你们都要同心，彼此体恤，相爱如弟兄，存慈怜谦卑的心。
3.en: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

3.zh: 不以恶报恶，以辱骂还辱骂，倒要祝福；因你们是为此蒙召，好叫你们承受福气。
3.en: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

3.zh: 因为[经上]说： 人若爱生命， 愿享美福， 须要禁止舌头不出恶言， 嘴唇不说诡诈的话；
3.en: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

3.zh: 也要离恶行善， 寻求和睦，一心追赶。
3.en: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

3.zh: 因为，主的眼看顾义人； 主的耳听他们的祈祷。 惟有行恶的人，主向他们变脸。
3.en: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

3.zh: 你们若是热心行善，有谁害你们呢？
3.en: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

3.zh: 你们就是为义受苦，也是有福的。不要怕人的威吓，也不要惊慌；
3.en: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”

3.zh: 只要心里尊主基督为圣。有人问你们心中盼望的缘由，就要常作准备，以温柔、敬畏的心回答各人；
3.en: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

3.zh: 存着无亏的良心，叫你们在何事上被毁谤，就在何事上可以叫那诬赖你们在基督里有好品行的人自觉羞愧。
3.en: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

3.zh: 神的旨意若是叫你们因行善受苦，总强如因行恶受苦。
3.en: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

3.zh: 因基督也曾一次为罪受苦，就是义的代替不义的，为要引我们到　神面前。按着肉体说，他被治死；按着灵性说，他复活了。
3.en: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

3.zh: 他借这灵曾去传道给那些在监狱里的灵听，
3.en: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

3.zh: 就是那从前在挪亚预备方舟、　神容忍等待的时候，不信从的人。当时进入方舟，借着水得救的不多，只有八个人。
3.en: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

3.zh: 这水所表明的洗礼，现在借着耶稣基督复活也拯救你们；[这洗礼]本不在乎除掉肉体的污秽，只求在　神面前有无亏的良心。
3.en: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

3.zh: 耶稣已经进入天堂，在　神的右边；众天使和有权柄的，并有能力的，都服从了他。
3.en: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

4.zh: 基督既在肉身受苦，你们也当将这样的心志作为兵器，因为在肉身受过苦的，就已经与罪断绝了。
4.en: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

4.zh: 你们存这样的心，从今以后就可以不从人的情欲，只从　神的旨意在世度余下的光阴。
4.en: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

4.zh: 因为往日随从外邦人的心意行邪淫、恶欲、醉酒、荒宴、群饮，并可恶拜偶像的事，时候已经够了。
4.en: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

4.zh: 他们在这些事上，见你们不与他们同奔那放荡无度的路，就以为怪，毁谤你们。
4.en: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

4.zh: 他们必在那将要审判活人死人的主面前交帐。
4.en: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

4.zh: 为此，就是死人也曾有福音传给他们，要叫他们的肉体按着人受审判，他们的灵性却靠　神活着。
4.en: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

4.zh: 万物的结局近了。所以，你们要谨慎自守，警醒祷告。
4.en: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

4.zh: 最要紧的是彼此切实相爱，因为爱能遮掩许多的罪。
4.en: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

4.zh: 你们要互相款待，不发怨言。
4.en: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

4.zh: 各人要照所得的恩赐彼此服事，作　神百般恩赐的好管家。
4.en: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

4.zh: 若有讲道的，要按着　神的圣言讲；若有服事[人]的，要按着　神所赐的力量服事，叫　神在凡事上因耶稣基督得荣耀。[原来]荣耀、权能都是他的，直到永永远远。阿们！
4.en: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

4.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，有火炼的试验临到你们，不要以为奇怪（似乎是遭遇非常的事），
4.en: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

4.zh: 倒要欢喜；因为你们是与基督一同受苦，使你们在他荣耀显现的时候，也可以欢喜快乐。
4.en: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

4.zh: 你们若为基督的名受辱骂，便是有福的；因为　神荣耀的灵常住在你们身上。
4.en: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

4.zh: 你们中间却不可有人因为杀人、偷窃、作恶、好管闲事而受苦。
4.en: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

4.zh: 若为作基督徒受苦，却不要羞耻，倒要因这名归荣耀给　神。
4.en: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

4.zh: 因为时候到了，审判要从　神的家起首。若是先从我们起首，那不信从　神福音的人将有何等的结局呢？
4.en: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

4.zh: 若是义人仅仅得救，那不虔敬和犯罪的人将有何地可站呢？
4.en: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

4.zh: 所以，那照　神旨意受苦的人要一心为善，将自己灵魂交与那信实的造化之主。
4.en: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

5.zh: 我这作长老、作基督受苦的见证、同享后来所要显现之荣耀的，劝你们中间与我同作长老的人：
5.en: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

5.zh: 务要牧养在你们中间　神的群羊，按着　神[旨意]照管他们；不是出于勉强，乃是出于甘心；也不是因为贪财，乃是出于乐意；
5.en: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

5.zh: 也不是辖制所托付你们的，乃是作群羊的榜样。
5.en: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

5.zh: 到了牧长显现的时候，你们必得那永不衰残的荣耀冠冕。
5.en: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

5.zh: 你们年幼的，也要顺服年长的。就是你们众人也都要以谦卑束腰，彼此顺服；因为 　神阻挡骄傲的人， 赐恩给谦卑的人。
5.en: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

5.zh: 所以，你们要自卑，服在　神大能的手下，到了时候，他必叫你们升高。
5.en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

5.zh: 你们要将一切的忧虑卸给　神，因为他顾念你们。
5.en: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

5.zh: 务要谨守，警醒。[因为]你们的仇敌魔鬼，如同吼叫的狮子，遍地游行，寻找可吞吃的人。
5.en: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

5.zh: 你们要用坚固的信心抵挡他，因为知道你们在世上的众弟兄也是经历这样的苦难。
5.en: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

5.zh: 那赐诸般恩典的　神曾在基督里召你们，得享他永远的荣耀，等你们暂受苦难之后，必要亲自成全你们，坚固你们，赐力量给你们。
5.en: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

5.zh: 愿权能归给他，直到永永远远。阿们！
5.en: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

5.zh: 我略略地写了这信，托我所看为忠心的兄弟西拉转交你们，劝勉你们，又证明这恩是　神的真恩。你们务要在这恩上站立得住。
5.en: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

5.zh: 在巴比伦与你们同蒙拣选的教会问你们安。我儿子马可也问你们安。
5.en: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

5.zh: 你们要用爱心彼此亲嘴问安。愿平安归与你们凡在基督里的人！
5.en: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
